claim: The Engram demo implements tokenizer compression with an NFKC/NFD/StripAccents/Lowercase/whitespace-collapse normalizer chain and hashes n-grams with multiplicative-XOR mixing over per-layer odd multipliers into prime-sized per-head buckets.
stance_target: How deterministic Engram addressing is actually computed
